title: Home page refresh
summary: The home page's feature cards now scroll by slowly, and the note from the maker sits right after "Where it all began".
items: "Everything around the ledger" is one row of screenshots that drifts sideways; scroll it yourself, or pause it with the button.
Visitors who prefer reduced motion see a still row.
"Why did I create Lootsplitter?" now follows the loot section.
